string.ContactEmailVisible: This email will be visible in the catalog. It does not determine package ownership.

string.PackageReadersDescription: These accounts can view and install every version of a private package. They cannot publish releases or manage access. Removing access does not remove downloaded files or installed definitions. Public packages remain visible to all registered accounts.
string.TransferPackageOwnershipDescription: The new owner can publish releases and manage access. You will lose these rights and private catalog access unless it is granted again. The original author, package identity and existing releases are preserved. The contact email will be cleared.
string.ConfirmPackageOwnershipTransfer: I understand that I will lose ownership

string.NoPublishedPackages: No published packages yet. Create a package from a card type or process, or publish an exported file.
